name: National Emergency Response System
description: Unified single emergency helpline for Police, Fire, and Ambulance emergencies across all States and Union Territories.

name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Helpline
description: Report financial frauds, UPI scams, identity theft, unauthorized account debits immediately to freeze funds within the golden hour.

name: National Legal Services Authority (NALSA) Helpline
description: Free legal aid and advice for women, children, scheduled castes/tribes, disabled, and low-income citizens across all District and Taluka courts.

name: National Consumer Helpline (NCH)
description: Assistance for consumer disputes, e-commerce refunds, defective electronics, warranty defaults, and airline/railway complaints.

name: Women in Distress Helpline
description: Emergency response, counseling, shelter home referral, and legal guidance for women facing domestic violence, harassment, or abuse.

name: Childline Emergency Service
description: 24-hour free emergency service for children in need of care and protection, child labor rescue, and runaway children support.

name: Kisan Call Centre (Agriculture)
description: Expert advice on crop advisories, PM-Kisan installment tracking, seed subsidies, fertilizer prices, and weather alerts.

name: Elderline (Senior Citizens National Helpline)
description: Free information, guidance on pensions, maintenance of parents under Maintenance and Welfare of Parents Act 2007, and emotional support.
